name: Fall 2024 Club Soccer Tryouts!
description: Tuesday September 3 and Thursday September 5 the Men's Club soccer team will be hosting tryouts for the upcoming academic year! Tryouts will be from 6:30-8PM on the upper NV field. Please arrive at 6pm on Tuesday in order to register for tryouts!

name: League Game Against Georgia Tech
description: The Furman University Men's Club Soccer team will play Georgia Tech for their second home league game.
